3. Blade & Shade Hybrid Combo Brow (Texture and density combined)
4. Velvet Lip Blushing & Full Lip Pigmentation (3–5 year contour and color wash)
5. Lash Line Enhancement & Winged Eyeliner
6. Paramedical 3D Areola Restoration (100% FREE for Breast Cancer Survivors healed 6+ months)
7. Medical Scar & Stretch Mark Camouflage (Skin-tone formulation)
8. Collagen Induction Therapy / Microneedling (Hyaluronic acid & stem cell infusion)
